LEGAL NOTICE: Case - Triple Network Default & Fraud - calaudit.org

To Martha Santana-Chin and L.A. Care Legal Counsel,

I am a high-risk seizure patient in a state of crisis caused by L.A. Care's systemic failure to oversee its networks. I am formally putting you on notice of a Triple Network Default.

1. Midnight Abandonment (Transport Network):
On March 16, 2026, your system violated the 10-minute wait limit (CCR Title 28) by holding me for 27 minutes and 32 seconds before an agent ("Sergio") denied my mandated NMT transport.

2. Documented Provider Fraud (Medical Network):
I have filed formal complaints with the Board of Registered Nursing (Complaint #4002026006579) and the Attorney General (Submission #20260326183738) regarding NP Kifle Gashie Jikamo (License #95142520) for billing fraud (Claim # [redacted]) and misrepresenting credentials.

3. Technical Obstruction of Therapy (Pharmacy Network):
I have filed a formal complaint with the California Board of Pharmacy (Complaint #PHAR-20260316-54013) against CVS Pharmacy #09785. I have documented that Pharmacist Hoang Dang (RPH #52538) falsely claimed medication was "out of stock". I performed a live technical audit of the pharmacy's dispensing system, bypassed the manual "out-of-stock" override, and successfully filled the prescription from the same bulk stock Dang claimed did not exist.

4. Statutory Default & Legal Action:
L.A. Care is in statutory default regarding my expedited grievance (HSC § 1368.01). You have been served in Case for $12,500. I demand immediate manual override of my $2,307.00 Conlan reimbursement.

I will not sign any NDAs.

Sincerely,

Nicolas_Hernandez
CalAudit.org
